mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, signaled by a positive YoY change in real GDP, indicates a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 YoY growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, signaled by a 3% MoM decline in INDPRO, indicates a supply shock that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 55% of instances where INDPRO drops > 3% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate, signaled by a 0.5pp increase in UNRATE over 3 months, indicates a weakening labor market that will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 45% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A flattening yield curve, signaled by a narrowing spread between 10-year and 2-year Treasury yields, indicates a tightening of financial conditions that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: 10y-2y yield spread narrows by > 20bps in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 55% of instances where the 10y-2y spread flattens by > 20bps in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong housing starts and rising consumer spending indicates a robust economic expansion that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS are both rising YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the CPI inflation rate, signaled by a 1% MoM rise in CPIAUCSL, indicates a supply-side inflation shock that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in payroll employment, signaled by a 200k MoM decline in PAYEMS, indicates a labor market shock that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS drops > 200k MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the federal funds rate, signaled by a 50bps increase in FEDFUNDS over 1 month, indicates a tightening of monetary policy that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 45% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises > 50bps in 1 month.
